company.name: WareIQ
company.shortDescription: eCommerce fulfillment company with same/next day delivery for modern consumer brands in India
company.description:
WareIQ is an eCommerce fulfillment platform for multi-channel consumer brands in India, with same/next day delivery options.

Through its tech-platform, WareIQ connects a nation-wide network of fulfillment centers and last-mile couriers offering Amazon-grade logistics.

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive fulfillment service combining a pan-India network of warehouses and a SaaS platform to manage inventory and orders for eCommerce brands across D2C, marketplace, B2B, and quick commerce channels.
productsAndServices.name: End-to-End eCommerce Fulfillment Solution

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled inventory planning tool that helps brands optimize stock levels, reduce holding costs, and increase product availability by regional placement of inventory.
productsAndServices.name: InventoryLogIQ

productsAndServices.description: A fulfillment service focused on fast delivery for quick commerce platforms like Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart through strategic inventory placement and same/next day delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Quick Commerce Fulfillment

productsAndServices.description: A service that prepares and manages inventory to comply with Amazon's Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) requirements, facilitating easier scaling on Amazon.
productsAndServices.name: Amazon FBA Preparation

productsAndServices.description: A service to help brands prepare and manage inventory and orders in compliance with Flipkart's marketplace requirements to support business scaling.
productsAndServices.name: Flipkart Preparation

productsAndServices.description: A fulfillment service designed to simplify retail and business-to-business order fulfillment strategies for brands.
productsAndServices.name: B2B Fulfillment
